scripts.fmt:commit: bunx prettier --write . && git add -A && git commit --no-verify -m "chore(fmt): code formatting"
scripts.ltf: bun fmt && bun lint && bun typecheck && bun test --retry=5 --only-failures --parallel
scripts.ltf:check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run fmt:check && bun test --retry=5 --only-failures --parallel
